slices.focus: Winter illness wave tests system; filled request rate holds near target
slices.summary: The winter illness wave at the courthouse — exactly the kind of predictable seasonal stress that used to collapse coverage — is handled without a major failure. The binder, backup tiers, and second-round trainees work together: minor reshuffling instead of full-day crises. The filled-request rate stays near Lucia's long-term target for the first time. She plans to present this to leadership as 'here is why we should keep protecting it' rather than 'look, it works,' narrating the near-misses to prevent complacency. She also plans a short after-action note on the binder and a proposal for clearer trainee progression thresholds, converting this stress test into durable structure.
